definition: שַׁבְּלוּל noun masculine snail (Shaph`el form, causing moisture , from notion of moisture or fluid in בלל ); — name due to slimy trail Ps 58:9 , שַׁבְּלוּל תֶּמֶס יַהֲלֹךְ .
